basic_info.description: Located on a beautiful and quiet block in San Francisco's highly desirable Marina neighborhood, this building has become an icon with its grandiose classic Spanish architecture and imposing facade. Classic architecture, beautiful detailing, large South-facing garden and a 3+ car garage make this impressive property wonderful for a home with significant rental income, or conversion to a single family home. The house is walking distance from fabulous award winning restaurants and shopping on Chestnut Street, the Marina Green, Union Street and Fort Mason.  Perfect location to enjoy a fabulous contemporary urban lifestyle in one of the City's most popular residential neighborhoods.
